purpose: Design for checking formal references between documents and notifying change-impact candidates when a referenced target changes, plus the consistency checks built on them.
summary: Extraction of formal references from reference-link definition titles ending in a DLID, with the optional recorded content hash
Real directory scanning to classify references as match, path mismatch, absent, or fragment mismatch, with duplicate diagnostics
Values to write into titles of links lacking a DLID, derived from the current target content
Reverse reference construction from scanned sources, limited to documents and sections in the confirmed ToC
Impact detection by comparing recorded title hashes with the current hashes of referenced targets
Direct referrers only; indirect impact is detected one step at a time
Notification contract: doc-link keeps no notification state and edits nothing; the project management AI judges and rewrites hashes
Behavior when the ToC is stale or no referrers are found
Consistency check division into check-dlid, check-links, check-toc, and check-impact
tasks: Implementing or modifying check-links and check-impact scripts
Designing reference extraction and title recording rules
Writing or rewriting reference links with content hashes in titles
Handling check-impact results after a referenced document changes
Diagnosing broken references, path mismatches, and fragment mismatches
Writing tests for reference checks and impact detection
title: DES-007 参照検査と[変更影響候補の通知]
